'''Egniol potions''' are a type of potion that can be made whilst in the [[Gauntlet]]. It restores prayer, 40% run energy, and acts as a [[stamina potion]].

==Effects==
Prayer restore is calculated with: <math>\lfloor PrayerLevel \times \frac{1}{4} \rfloor + 7</math>

==Creation==
#Fill a [[Vial (The Gauntlet)|vial]] with water at a [[Water Pump (The Gauntlet)|Water Pump]] or fishing spot to receive a [[water-filled vial]].
#Use a [[grym leaf]] on the water-filled vial to receive a [[grym potion (unf)]].
#Use a [[Pestle and mortar (The Gauntlet)|pestle and mortar]] with ten [[Crystal shards (The Gauntlet)|crystal shards]] to receive ten [[Crystal dust (The Gauntlet)|crystal dust]].
#Use the ten crystal dust with the grym potion (unf) to receive an Egniol potion (3).
